channel.title: NET Law-Verse Blog
channel.description: UGC NET Law (058), CLAT PG and AIBE exam updates, legal current affairs and study guides.

item.title: AIBE 22 on 29 Nov: Exam Pattern, Passing Marks, Last-Week Plan
item.description: AIBE 22 is on 29 November 2026: 100 MCQs, no negative marking, 45% to pass (40% SC/ST). Pattern, what to carry, and a day-by-day plan for the final week.

item.title: AIBE Subject-Wise Weightage: Which Subjects Carry Most Marks
item.description: AIBE subject-wise weightage for the 100 questions: Constitution, CrPC and CPC carry 10 each. See the full table and how to split your study time.

item.title: CLAT PG 2027 on 6 Dec: Exam Pattern, Marking, Last-Week Plan
item.description: CLAT PG 2027 is on 6 December 2026: 120 passage-based MCQs in 2 hours, negative marking of 0.25. See the pattern, the attempt maths and a day-by-day plan.

item.title: CLAT PG Eligibility 2027: Marks, Age Limit and Attempts
item.description: What is CLAT PG eligibility? An LLB with 50% marks (45% SC/ST), no age limit and no cap on attempts. Also: what PG means in CLAT and whether UG or PG is better.

item.title: CLAT PG in 1 Month or 4 Months? Study Plan and Coaching Guide
item.description: Is 4 months enough for CLAT PG? Can you prepare in 1 month? Get a week-by-week plan for both, plus an honest guide to choosing coaching or self-study.

item.title: CLAT PG Syllabus 2027: Subject-Wise Topics and Priorities
item.description: CLAT PG syllabus 2027 subject by subject: Constitutional Law, Jurisprudence, new criminal laws, Contract, Torts and more, with what to revise first.

item.title: How to Solve CLAT PG Passage-Based Questions: 5-Step Method
item.description: A five-step method to solve CLAT PG passage-based MCQs faster, with a worked example on the basic structure doctrine and the common traps to avoid.

item.title: IPC to BNS, CrPC to BNSS Section Mapping for AIBE
item.description: IPC to BNS, CrPC to BNSS and Evidence Act to BSA section mapping for AIBE: murder, theft, bail, FIR, electronic evidence and more in one table.

item.title: Is 60 a Good Score in CLAT PG? 40 and 77 Marks Explained
item.description: Is 60 a good score in CLAT PG? Is 77 or 40? What each score means out of 120, how negative marking changes it, and how CLAT compares with IIT.

item.title: UGC NET December 2026 Exam Dates: NTA Schedule, City Slip and Admit Card
item.description: NTA has released the UGC NET December 2026 schedule: exams on 14 to 18 and 21 December in two CBT shifts. Confirmed dates, how to find your Law (058) slot, and what to do now.

item.title: UGC NET Law 058: 3-Week Revision Plan Before the December 2026 Exam
item.description: A practical 3-week revision routine for UGC NET Law (058) and Paper 1: what to revise each week, how to use mock tests and PYQs, and a final-48-hours checklist.
